# Sifat Bhatia: Design Engineer & Creative Technologist

## About

Sifat Bhatia is a Los Angeles-based design engineer with 7+ years designing and building websites and web products for music, entertainment, agency, and nonprofit clients. His work spans visual design and brand identity in Figma, frontend development in React, Next.js, and TypeScript, and backend development with Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase, and Stripe.

He founded Siftion, an independent design and development studio, in 2018. Projects run from scoping and visual direction through development, launch, and ongoing support.

## Expertise

- **Frontend:** TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, HTML, CSS, GSAP, Framer Motion
- **Backend:** Node.js, tRPC, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Supabase, REST APIs, WebSockets, Stripe
- **Design:** Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, design systems, brand identity, typography, editorial layout
- **Platforms:** Webflow, WordPress (PHP), Squarespace, Vercel, Git, Linux
- **Quality:** Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, responsive design

## Experience

- **Siftion:** Founder & Design Engineer, 2018–Present
- **QLO Agency:** Webflow Developer (Contract), 2024–Present
- **L'Affaire Musicale & Wicked Paradise:** In-House Web Designer & Developer (Contract), March 2019–October 2026. This engagement has ended.
- **Star Consciousness:** Web Designer & WordPress Developer, 2023–Present
- **Los Angeles City College:** Program Assistant, Noncredit Department, August 2023–2025
- **Super Purposes:** Web Developer Intern, November 2022–May 2023
- **Ego Digital Agency:** Web Designer & Developer, March 2021–February 2022

## Selected Work

### J. Worra

Sole designer and developer for the artist's brand and website since 2018. Scope includes brand direction, logo, every website iteration, technical SEO, analytics, and continuing web support for releases, tours, press, booking, and marketing. The current Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS site uses the Spotify Web API for releases and discography.

### L'Affaire Musicale

Brand identity and website refresh for a dance-music management company, moving from an event-page feel toward clearer roster presentation, typography, and inquiry paths. Part of a contract engagement from March 2019 to October 2026, including UI/UX direction, style guides, website management, SEO, and roster artists' sites.

### QLO Agency

Ongoing contract Webflow development since 2024. Editorial layouts, responsive pages, reusable components, CMS collections, native interactions, and editing structures that preserve visual consistency. Accessibility, Core Web Vitals, and technical SEO reviewed before handoff.

### Wicked Paradise

Website direction, UI/UX, style guides, SEO, and maintenance for L'Affaire Musicale's sister event brand. The contract ran from March 2019 to October 2026 and has ended.

### WillCall

A working full-stack prototype of an event-discovery and ticket-drop platform, not a claim of a launched ticketing business. Next.js, TypeScript, tRPC, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Stripe guest checkout, rotating HMAC-SHA256 QR tickets, and WebSocket-driven live event state.

### ClipKeep

A local-first library for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube links, with collections, favorites, search, optional encrypted Supabase sync, and experimental AI summaries with a fallback when unavailable.
